summary: Adds email search to the users index, a self-service profile update, a destroy action, and a welcome email callback on User.

findings.title: SQL injection in email search
findings.problem: The index action interpolates the q request parameter straight into the SQL string. Any authenticated caller controls the WHERE clause.
findings.consequence: A caller can read every column of every user, including api_token, or alter the query freely.
findings.fix: Pass the value as a bound parameter and escape the LIKE wildcards.

findings.title: Destroy skips the admin check
findings.problem: The before_action exempts destroy from require_admin. The destroy action then finds any user by id with no scoping to the caller.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can delete any other user account, including admins.
findings.fix: Remove destroy from the except list so only admins reach it, or scope the lookup to the current user.

findings.title: Profile update permits every attribute
findings.problem: The profile action permits every key in the user params and writes them all to the record. The caller can therefore set any column, including the admin flag and api_token.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can promote themselves to admin or overwrite their token, which breaks the authorization model.
findings.fix: Permit an explicit list of profile fields instead of permitting everything.

findings.title: Welcome email sent on every save
findings.problem: The callback uses after_save, so the mailer runs on every update as well as on create. The new profile action updates the user, so each profile edit sends another welcome email.
findings.consequence: Users receive a welcome email every time they or an admin edit their record.
findings.fix: Use after_create so the welcome email goes out once.

findings.title: New actions have no tests
findings.problem: The change adds search, profile and destroy behaviour and a mailer callback. No test file in the repository exercises any of them.
findings.consequence: Regressions in authorization, search or the callback will reach production unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add controller tests for index search, profile and destroy, and a model test for the welcome email callback.
